Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.evaporation

Class PipelineEvaporationConfig

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.evaporation.PipelineEvaporationConfig
public class PipelineEvaporationConfig extends Object
Numerical and geometric settings for PipelineEvaporationStudy and PipelineDissolutionStudy.

Velocities are actual phase velocities, not superficial velocities. SI units are used throughout.
